description: List durable local money operations for the active account, including progress, terminal results, and exact recovery instructions. Provide outbound_only (true or false) to read engine Arc Home operations instead; true filters that view to outbound operations. This is a pure read.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID for the Arc Home view. Requires outbound_only.

limit.description: Maximum operations, 1-100 locally or 1-50 when outbound_only is provided. Defaults to 20.

outbound_only.description: Read engine Arc Home operations instead of the local journal. True includes only outbound operations; false includes all directions. Omit for the local journal.

name: list_recent_operations
